config.name: quick
config.model: u=h*z+e; z~CN(0,q), e~CN(0,sI); latent z and h unavailable to estimator
config.prior: Uniform on all native complex lines; not restricted to the ULA angle curve
config.primary: Parameter-inference pilot; primary decision study has its own 256-trajectory design.
config.replication: 64 stationary data sets per noise and 8 moving data sets per law/noise in paper profile; queries/draws are not repetitions.
config.stationary_model: One common complex-line projector, constant ordered a=s+q>b=s. Uniform state prior.
config.moving_model: Full path of 24 states, uniform state 1, 23 transitions, constant powers and concentration; G=I.
config.moving_controls: Known/fixed powers use single-Bingham assumed-density prediction; they are not exact full-path posterior references.
config.known_full_path_control: First two matched-motion data sets per noise have a separate known-power/known-kappa full-path Gibbs control, shared across priors; no outcome selection.
config.physical_scope: Deterministic ULA motion is a process mismatch; no true kappa is assigned.
config.prior_scope: Joint product IG(a)IG(b) restricted to a>b, with one global normalizer. Not independent s,q priors.
config.prospective_scope: Each fit uses observations through N only; the target is observation N+1 before assimilation.
config.decision_scope: Weights use the joint next covariance E[bI+(a-b)P_next], not a product of marginal means.
config.EM_scope: Every pre-correction prior is recorded once and frozen for EM; final correction and future prediction use fitted powers without refitting history.
config.mixing_scope: Three independent starts; ESS, split Rhat and between-chain tails are finite diagnostics, not convergence proofs.
config.display: Preassigned trial 0, s=.2, default prior; stationary N32 plus both moving laws. No outcome-based target selection.
config.excluded_raw: Full Gibbs state arrays are regenerated from seeded scripts; compact preassigned scalar draws and all per-fit diagnostics are committed.
